title: Detection of properness on strict localizations of the target
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to T$ be a finitely presented morphism from an algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Here finite presentation means quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness and local finite presentation on etale scheme charts [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. For every geometric point $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ [def-weil-geometric-point], let $T_{(\bar t)}=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{T,\bar t}$ be the strict localization with its canonical map to $T$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], and put $f_{(\bar t)}:X\times_TT_{(\bar t)}\to T_{(\bar t)}$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Then $f$ is proper if and only if $f_{(\bar t)}$ is proper for every geometric point $\bar t$, where proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties].

source.place: Agent-extracted strict-local corollary of Tag 08K1, lemma-eventually-proper, with strict localizations the pointed affine etale-neighbourhood limits (etale-cohomology.tex Tag 04HX, lemma-describe-etale-local-ring); etale descent: spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 083R, lemma-proper-local, or spaces-descent.tex Tag 0422. This corollary is not claimed to be the verbatim statement of 08K1.

proof.text: If $f$ is proper, apply proper base change to $T_{(\bar t)}\to T$ for each geometric point. Its projection is exactly $f_{(\bar t)}$, hence is proper.

Conversely assume every $f_{(\bar t)}$ proper and fix $\bar t$. Use the small cofiltered representative category $\mathcal J_{\bar t}$ and its affine-scheme limit $T_{(\bar t)}$ from the strict-localization definition, with its compatible maps over $T$. Every transition is affine: its source and target are affine, so the singleton covering by the whole target has affine inverse image, and the affine-local-target criterion applies (Stacks 01SH).

source.place: Tag 04HX, lemma-describe-etale-local-ring, pointed affine neighbourhood colimit; morphisms.tex Tag 01SH, lemma-morphism-affines-affine

proof.text: Apply cofiltered-limit directed reindexing to this small diagram and its limit cone. Obtain a small nonempty directed inverse system $(U_i)$ of affine pointed etale neighbourhoods, with affine transitions and limit $T_{(\bar t)}$, retaining the projections over $T$. Choose an index $i_0$.

Base change $f$ to $U_{i_0}$. It is finitely presented by finite-presentation base change. For $i\ge i_0$ its pullback to $U_i$ is $X\times_TU_i\to U_i$, and its limit pullback is $f_{(\bar t)}$, by associativity of fibre products and compatibility over $T$. Eventual properness therefore gives an $i\ge i_0$ with $X\times_TU_i\to U_i$ proper. All stages are affine; the initial morphism is finitely presented, and the limit morphism is proper, exactly as the cited theorem requires. The pointed lift $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U_i$ ensures its image contains $t$.

source.place: Tags 084W and 08K1, situation-descent-property and lemma-eventually-proper; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 03XR, lemma-base-change-finite-presentation

proof.text: Take a set of representatives of the affine etale maps $U\to T$ for which $X\times_TU\to U$ is proper. This family is jointly surjective: any $t\in T$ has a geometric point given by an algebraic closure of $\kappa(t)$, and step 4 supplies a member whose pointed lift lies over $t$. Each member is flat and locally of finite presentation by the definition of etale. Thus this family is an fppf covering by the definition of that topology. If $T$ is empty the empty family has the same covering property.
Apply the properness clause of fppf locality to this covering. Every pullback is proper by the choice of its members, hence $f$ is proper. Together with step 1 this proves the equivalence.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q82-3ce95a835 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all 13 cited nodes in full. The delivery adds no new nodes and does not change the statement. Sources checked: spaces-limits.tex 08K1 (lemma-eventually-proper) in Situation 084W, etale-cohomology.tex 04HX (strict localization as a limit of pointed affine étale neighbourhoods) and spaces-descent.tex 0422 (properness is fpqc local on the base). The statement is true: finite presentation is what makes the converse work. It holds in the small cases I tested (algebraically closed point, empty T, a DVR base). No duplicate exists: I searched dag/nodes with rg -L for strict-local or strict-henselization together with proper and algebraic space; eventually-proper, qcqs-base-eventually-proper and representable-proper-fppf-target-test are different statements. Step 1 is lem-sfb-space-proper-base-change applied to the structural map. Step 2 (elementary) takes the small cofiltered affine neighbourhood category J and its scheme limit from def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit; a morphism between affine schemes is affine by the one-member cover in pqf-lem-affine-local-target. Step 3 is the directed reindexing leaf lem-weil-pbc-cofiltered-limit-directed-reindex. Its statement omits that the directed set is small, but its Mathlib declaration IsFiltered.exists_directed (Directed.lean:545) returns α : Type w, so it is small; I note this as advisory. Step 4 meets every hypothesis of lem-sfb-space-eventually-proper: the stages are affine with affine transitions; X×_T U_{i0} is finitely presented by the base-change clause of fp-locality; the limit pullback is f_(t̄) by fibre-product associativity; the lift of t̄ puts t in the image. Step 5 (elementary) restricts the set of representatives from affine-etale-essentially-small-cover to those with proper pullback. That family is jointly surjective using algebraic closures of κ(t). Étale implies flat and locally finitely presented, so it is an fppf covering. Step 6 is the properness clause of fp-locality. Batch-5 flags: eventually-proper, flat-proper-fp-locality and proper-base-change are general algebraic-space lemmas (Stacks 08K1, 0422, 04WP). They reach sec-trace-formula only through the definition def-trf-algebraic-space and the generic fibre-product lemma, and they are not part of the trace formula or Poincaré duality or their proofs, so I accept all three. I also accept the tool_uses entry for lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers: it is generic fibre products, it is already a stmt_dep, and no node of this unit gives it. The route stays in unit sk-thm-sf-ctf-stability and cites no SGA. Full checks are in review.md.
